A reversible complete-gap sequence must be a run of A or an alternating B,C run. Boundary contexts cap its total length by a²+3a−1 for a>=4; the explicit palindromic W_3 factor of that length proves sharpness. The a=3 localization lemma says every length-19 factor occurs in W_3 of length 85, because length<=|W_2|=21 and all two-copy boundaries occur in W_3. Independently reconstructed its complete 37-factor certificate with no reversed pair and its length-18 palindrome. Any reversible longer factor contains a reversible length-19 subfactor. Finite samples at a=4..8 merely corroborate the proved infinite family.
